group_results.reason: The announced preservation of invalid UTF-32 codepoints is in the target's normalization surface, but its direct calls always use length zero and omit UTF8PROC_COMPOSE. The marker behavior has a separate map route.
This change adds only a NEWS issue link; it changes no operation or supported behavior of the fuzz entry.
The added test specifies marker emission for CHARBOUND combined with COMPOSE or DECOMPOSE. The entry calls both combinations on fuzzer supplied, NUL-terminated bytes; the test input is admissible.
The added tests specify preservation and composition barriers for out-of-range and sentinel UTF-32 words. The target's direct normalizer calls cannot supply a nonempty buffer or request composition.
The changed COMPOSE branch preserves invalid words and resets composition state. All direct calls from this entry have zero length and options without COMPOSE.

build.reason: The supplied build recipe delegates to test/ossfuzz.sh, whose contents are unavailable; the CMake target alone does not establish the delegated build.

input.reason: The entry accepts NUL-terminated bytes, but allocates its UTF-32 copy only when size is below four, then divides that size by four. Thus every direct normalization call has length zero.

lifecycle.reason: The entry frees its copy and map results, but the supplied packet lacks the map contract needed to establish result ownership and error-path state.

control_flow.reason: The changed branch requires UTF8PROC_COMPOSE and a nonempty UTF-32 buffer. The entry's direct calls satisfy neither condition.

accepted.requirement: Reach utf8proc_normalize_utf32 with UTF8PROC_COMPOSE and a nonempty UTF-32 sequence containing an out-of-range word or grapheme sentinel, so preservation and the composition barrier are exercised.
accepted.failure_condition: The copy exists only for size below four; size divided by four is then zero. None of the six calls includes UTF8PROC_COMPOSE.
accepted.alternative_paths: The map calls operate on byte strings; they do not provide an equivalent route to observe preservation of an invalid UTF-32 word. The separate CHARBOUND map calls reach marker behavior, not this direct UTF-32 result.
